text.en: Feedback on animal handling at the Colonnade salon is divided. While one client praised the care given during a dog's bath and another enjoyed volunteering with the kittens in-store, two long-time dachshund owners expressed disappointment over how their anxious or challenging dogs were received during recent grooming visits.

title.en: Praise for Karla alongside service complaints

text.en: Opinions on the salon team vary across recent visits on East Camelback Road. One dog owner warmly recommended stylist Karla for her work, whereas two six-year customers reported dissatisfaction, including an encounter with a staff member described as rude when checking in a nervous dog.

Visitors report contrasting outcomes at this Phoenix location. One reviewer was delighted with their dog's bath and haircut and another found the branch decent overall, but a long-term client was unhappy with their female dachshund's second grooming visit and another noted a scheduling mix-up.

q.en: Which stylist is recommended at PetSmart Grooming Colonnade?

a.en: One recent reviewer specifically recommended groomer Karla for a thorough bath and haircut.

q.en: Does the Colonnade grooming salon accept walk-in services?

a.en: Yes, walk-in nail trims and pawdicure treatments are offered alongside scheduled full-service baths and haircuts.

q.en: Have clients reported issues with appointment scheduling?

a.en: Yes, a long-time customer mentioned that an appointment was scheduled incorrectly and noted friction at check-in with an anxious dog.
